opener: This is the Robo Cranes, from Grulla Elementary!
Last season, we made it all the way to the VEX World Championship.
This year, the game is Level Up.
We stack bean bags higher and higher, and we learn something new every day.
v1: Hi Robo Cranes! I'm Cranebot, and this is Flop, our robot!
Flop has five parts, just like a body.
Wheels are Flop's legs: they drive and turn.
The intake is Flop's mouth: it grabs bean bags and spits them out.
The arm is Flop's neck: it lifts bags up high, just like my long crane neck!
The camera is Flop's eyes: it sees red, blue and yellow.
And the bumper is Flop's nose: boop!
Five parts, one robot, one team. Let's build it!
v2: How do we score in Level Up? With bean bags!
Drop a bean bag in the floor goal: one point.
Put it on top of the pyramid: three points!
Put a bag ON TOP of another bag on the pyramid, and it reaches the next level: six points!
So the best teams drop every bag in the exact same spot, so they stack.
One, three, six. Higher means more points!
v3: Bean bags come in three colors.
Red bags go on the red goal.
Blue bags go on the blue goal.
If a bag is the wrong color, or still touching the robot, it's zero points.
Match the color, let it go, and score!
v4: Flop can do things one at a time: drive... stop... then lift the arm.
Or Flop can do two things at once: lift the arm WHILE it drives.
In VEXcode, click the little arrow on the arm block and pick 'and don't wait.'
Now the next block starts right away.
It's like walking and chewing gum at the same time.
Save a second here, a second there, and you'll have time for more bean bags!
v5: Every time Flop turns, it can be a tiny bit wrong.
But after many turns, the mistakes add up, and Flop gets lost!
The fix: instead of 'turn right 90,' use 'turn to heading.'
That means 'face that direction,' like 'face the window.'
Flop checks its compass every time, so mistakes don't pile up.
finale: We'll build a robot, code a robot, drive a robot, and do it as a team.
